title: Bank Account Ledger
description: Process m ledger commands, one per line. OPEN <name> <balance> creates an account with its OWN balance; DEPOSIT <name> <amt> adds amt to that account only; BALANCE <name> prints the account's balance, or UNKNOWN when the account does not exist. Each account's state must live on its own instance: state stored on the class is shared by every account and corrupts the others, and fields the constructor never assigns stay missing. This problem establishes the C7 base skill of classes, constructors, and instance state.
constraints: Names have 1 to 20 letters; 0 <= balance, amt <= 1000000000.
input_format: First line: an integer m. Next m lines: commands OPEN <name> <balance>, DEPOSIT <name> <amt>, or BALANCE <name>.
output_format: One line per BALANCE command: the balance, or UNKNOWN.

public_tests.input:
3
OPEN amy 100
DEPOSIT amy 50
BALANCE amy
